title: Coherence of the open pullback cube
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ be a commutative scheme square [def-pc-scheme], so $g\prime\gg f=f\prime\gg g$. Let $V\subset S$, $V\prime\subset S\prime$ with $V\prime\subset g^{-1}V$, put $U=f^{-1}V$, $U\prime=f\prime{}^{-1}V\prime$, and let $j:U\prime\to U$ commute both with the inclusions and with the restricted arrows $f_0,f_0\prime,g_0$. Give every scheme its derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. For $M\in D(\mathcal O_S)$, let $q:Lf\prime{}^*Lg^*\cong Lg\prime{}^*Lf^*$ and $q_0:Lf_0\prime{}^*Lg_0^*\cong Lj^*Lf_0^*$ be the pinned composition square comparisons [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Write $d_f,d_{f\prime},d_g,d_{g\prime}$ for the constructed open pullback squares [def-pc-t2-open-pullback-square-iso], and $R_S,R_{X\prime}$ for open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Then $q_0(R_SM)\gg Lj^*(d_f(M))\gg d_{g\prime}(Lf^*M)=Lf_0\prime{}^*(d_g(M))\gg d_{f\prime}(Lg^*M)\gg R_{X\prime}(q(M))$. No direct images, counits, cartesianness, or base-change arrows occur.

proof.text: Expand the open square comparisons. Naturality moves open pullback comparisons through adjacent functors; cancel inverse open comparisons. Apply associativity of the pinned composition comparisons to j,U inclusion,f; U prime inclusion,g prime,f; f prime restricted,V prime inclusion,g; and j,f restricted,V inclusion. The commuting cube equations identify all total morphisms. Equality transports agree by proof irrelevance. Cancel the remaining composition comparisons to obtain the displayed identity, without any nonempty or boundedness assumption.
